# Agent Python Tools

- repo: berriai/litellm
- repo_uri: https://github.com/berriai/litellm

## File: berriai_litellm/litellm/llms/base_llm/batches/transformation.py

Prompts

```
['build a provider-specific batch configuration class extending BaseBatchesConfig with all required abstract methods', 'test the BaseBatchesConfig.validate_environment method to prepare HTTP headers and parameters for a batch request', 'create a call to get_complete_batch_url that builds the full batch creation endpoint URL for a given provider', 'refactor transform_create_batch_request to convert CreateBatchRequest data into provider-specific JSON format', 'review transform_create_batch_response to convert a raw httpx.Response into a LiteLLMBatch object']
```

Usage

```
{'build_base_batches_config': 'build a provider-specific batch configuration class extending BaseBatchesConfig with all required abstract methods', 'test_validate_environment': 'test the BaseBatchesConfig.validate_environment method to prepare HTTP headers and parameters for a batch request', 'create_get_complete_batch_url': 'create a call to get_complete_batch_url that builds the full batch creation endpoint URL for a given provider', 'refactor_transform_create_batch_request': 'refactor transform_create_batch_request to convert CreateBatchRequest data into provider-specific JSON format', 'review_transform_create_batch_response': 'review transform_create_batch_response to convert a raw httpx.Response into a LiteLLMBatch object'}
```
